calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS before_ret, SUM(r.returns_net) AS rets
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'dup_sales_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_orders', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_returns', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_dispatched_status', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL SELECT 'test_cat_web_lines_in_range', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
